verdict.rationale: Amplitude docs explicitly cover retention-style analytics via funnels/segmentation and behavioral cohort creation/export (docs-5, docs-6, docs-18, docs-29), directly supporting cohort-based retention slicing. However, retention analysis specifically (a dedicated retention chart over time) isn't explicitly named in the pack, and community feedback raises data-accuracy/implementation concerns. Missing for 10: explicit mention of a 'retention chart' feature, and independent hands-on validation of retention accuracy over time.
